goal: Ship the solicitation_consent ledger (migration 093) and its ingest wiring so consent resolution becomes a ledger lookup gated by SEND_ELIGIBLE_ATTESTATION_VERSIONS, killing the consent_attested tautology and the §1.2 re-upload trap.
non_goals: No dispatch gate (§6.3) — that is #630's consent-row existence + allowlist check; #625 never touches solicitation_outreach
No consent snapshot stamping on outreach rows — stamped at DISPATCH by #630 per amendments B1
No suppression ledger reads or writes — #621/#626 own revocation entirely; no revoked_at column, ever (D7)
No owner-facing grant-consent action — the attestation checkbox is the only surface (§4.1)
No SMS consent rows (DR3) — channel CHECK ships email-only
No new env vars or feature flags — allowlist and attestation constants are code constants (§8.3)
No new withhold reason — case (b) is distinguished by evidence fields, not a new enum member (§6.1)

Spec §10 test 7 and the solicitation_consent_missing_at_dispatch event DEFERRED to #630 (map-owner decision 2026-07-30): both exercise the §6.3 dispatch gate, which #630 builds; §9's #625 row binds §3/§4/§6.1/§6.2/§7 only
user_visible_behavior: Uploading a CSV records/upgrades one solicitation_consent row per valid email row, inside the existing ingest transaction
The upload attestation checkbox text changes to the v2 wording (names email, opt-outs, and the sender-agent relationship); new uploads stamp consent_attestation_v2
Contacts covered only by v1 now withhold with no_consent case (b) (upload_id + attestation_version populated) instead of counting as attested — visible in watch-mode batch evidence
Re-uploading the same CSV under v2 upgrades consent rows even when every visit dedupes (duplicate_visit), making those contacts send-eligible — the §1.2 trap remedy
Deleting a contact deletes its consent rows by handle in the same transaction
Offboarding purge hard-deletes all consent rows via the businesses cascade, with an explicit TABLE_DISPOSITIONS entry and must_be_absent verification
invariants: Consent fails closed; suppression fails open (DR1) — consent rows are hard_delete on contact delete and purge
No consent row for a channel the attestation text did not name (DR3) — phone handles mint zero rows
Monotone forward only: the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE carries WHERE EXCLUDED.attested_at > solicitation_consent.attested_at (§4.2)
Ingest is the sole writer, inside the per-business advisory-locked transaction (D8)
attested_by_user_id is a plain UUID with NO FK — the 086 users cascade must not reach the ledger (§3.4)
source_upload_id FK is ON DELETE SET NULL — audit pointer only
No account_id column — business-scoped per 086's denormalization warning (§3.2)
RLS enabled, deny-all to browser — same posture as auto_approval_policies (invariant #14)
Re-running a csv_ingest job stays idempotent — the > guard makes replays no-ops without updated_at churn (§4.3)
evaluateAsk stays pure and unchanged — only the caller's derivation swaps (§6.1)
Never log or emit the raw handle — analytics properties carry channel/basis/version only (§8.1–8.2)
UUIDv7 worker-supplied PK per repo convention
edge_cases: In-flight pre-deploy csv_ingest job carrying v1 dispatches after the v2 deploy — the attested_at guard prevents the downgrade (§4.2)
Re-upload where zero visits insert (all duplicate_visit) must still upgrade consent rows (§1.2)
CSV row with phone but no email produces contacts/visits and no consent row (DR3)
Same handle at two businesses in one account: consent at A does not cover B (§3.2)
Contact deleted then same handle re-uploaded: stale consent must not survive to grant consent the owner did not re-give (§7.1 — silent-failure case, contract-tested)
Suppressed handle re-attested under v2: suppression still outranks (§5.2) — pure evaluateAsk precedence test
postgres.js microsecond truncation does not apply to the §4.2 guard (both operands in one statement) — recorded, not worked around
existing_patterns_to_follow: supabase/migrations/086_solicitation_contacts.sql — table conventions, RLS posture, comment style for the solicitation lane
src/lib/solicitation/ingest.ts ingestContactsCsvUpload tx + acquireCsvIngestLock — the transaction the consent upsert joins
restraint-policy.ts .2 doc-comment precedent for recording the .3 bump reason
tests_to_add: consent_attested is no longer a tautology: a contact covered only by consent_attestation_v1 yields attested: false
the §1.2 re-upload trap: re-uploading the identical CSV under v2 inserts zero visits AND leaves the contact send-eligible
monotonicity guard: a v1 write with an earlier attested_at cannot downgrade a v2 consent row
tenant scope: a consent row at business A does not make the same handle eligible at business B in the same account
contact delete sweeps consent rows by handle; re-uploading after delete requires a fresh attestation
suppression outranks a fresh attestation: an attested candidate with a suppression present still withholds as suppressed
evidence shape: both no_consent cases round-trip through parseEvidence and satisfy migration 090's CHECK
no SMS rows: a CSV with phone handles produces zero channel='sms' consent rows
monotone upsert idempotency: replaying the same csv_ingest job re-writes identical values as a no-op without updated_at churn
